title: Request Bodies with Pydantic
learning_objectives: Describe a JSON body as a Pydantic model with typed, constrained fields
Forbid unknown fields and choose strict types where coercion would hide errors
Receive a validated model in a POST endpoint
Compare Pydantic validation with the hand-written validator
entry_point: class Item(BaseModel); parse_item(data); app with POST /items
hints: `model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)` goes in the class body.
`price: float = Field(ge=0, strict=True)` and `quantity: int = Field(default=0, ge=0, strict=True)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Strip whitespace via model_config and give tags and quantity defaults.
Use `extra="forbid"`, `min_length=1` on name and a strict float price.
Strict numbers reject booleans and floats for ints; list[str] checks every tag; limit name to 50 characters.
The endpoint takes `item: Item` and returns the dumped model and price * quantity.
FastAPI reports body errors with loc ['body', field] when the model is the only body parameter.
